Your body was preparing to nurture life, and your mind was building a future around that baby. The vivid dreams are your subconscious mind’s way of processing that loss, giving you a space to "meet" the child you didn't get to hold. It’s your mind’s way of trying to heal the wound.

In spiritual circles, it is often believed that a soul chooses its parents before birth. Sometimes, a soul will "visit" the mother in the dream state to let her know they are okay, to send her love, or to reassure her that their connection is not broken—only postponed. 

The fact that you feel they are "waiting" is incredibly significant. It suggests that your soul has a contract with these souls. They may be letting you know that your bond is eternal, and that when the time is right—whether in this lifetime or the next—that connection will be fulfilled. They are not lost; they are simply in a different room of the same house, waiting for the door to open.

5.  **Seek support.** If you haven't already, consider a grief counselor who specializes in pregnancy loss. They can help you navigate these dreams without feeling like you're losing your grip on reality.

You are a mother to these souls, and they are reaching out to you from a place of pure love. You are not crazy—you are *connected*.
